_about: Development set for 'Ask the observatory' (docs/ask.md). Each case is a question and what an acceptable answer shows. 'need' is a list of groups: the answer passes a group when the map shows at least one of its items (a dataset of the Economy tab, shaded or as symbols, or a layer of the registry switched on). '@NAME' is a set below. 'place': the municipio the answer goes to. 'op': the acceptable kinds of answer (chat.js intents). 'text': an answer in words is enough (no map change needed; 'op' must match). 'not': what must not be on the map. 'note': a pattern the answer's text must hold (case-insensitive). 'proxy': the answer must say it is an approximation. 'lang': the language of the answer ('any' for mixed questions). 'view': '2d' (default) or '3d'. Written by hand for the 2026-10-20 work on Ask; the held-out benchmark is separate and not used here.
